02bAll Keywords: Ranking Comparison

Source: Google Maps grid scans  ·  Ember Gardens, 41 MA-6A, Orleans MA  ·  Baseline: May 12, 2026 · 10-mi radius, 9×9 grid   |   Weekly campaign (Jul 1 to Aug 24): 10-mi radius, 7×7 grid   |   Aug 25 onward: 10-mi radius, 7×7 grid (100 mi²)

What is Average Ranking Position (ARP)?
ARP is the average position Ember Gardens holds across every point on the map grid for a given search term. Lower is better. An ARP of 1.57 means the store is ranking #1 or #2 at nearly every grid point. An ARP of 3.56 means the store is averaging around position 3 to 4 across the grid, with some gaps where competitors are ahead.
What is Share of Local Voice (SoLV)?
SoLV is the percentage of grid points where Ember Gardens appears in the top 3 results on Google Maps. 100% means the store shows up in the top 3 everywhere across the scan area. 65% means there are roughly 35% of map locations where a competitor is outranking Ember Gardens in the top 3. Higher is better, and 80%+ is strong for a competitive cannabis market.

Ember Gardens ranks #2 on Cape Cod in both scan radii for "dispensary near me," sitting between Seaside Cannabis (the regional leader) and The Haven Center. At the 10-mile radius, the gap between Ember Gardens and Haven Center is narrow (ARP 2.76 vs 2.94, SoLV 81.6% vs 75.5%). At the 10-mile radius the gap stays tight (ARP 3.42 vs 3.46) but SoLV opens up (66.7% vs 61.7%), meaning Ember Gardens holds a stronger regional footprint. Seaside Cannabis is the benchmark to close on, particularly in the northern grid points toward Eastham where their dominance is strongest, and where September content is now focused.

⚠  Recommendation: Review Automation
Dan and the team have chosen not to proceed with iMessage review automation at this time. We want to flag that this is a missed opportunity. Review velocity is one of the strongest signals Google uses for local map pack rankings. Competitors like Seaside Cannabis are likely outranking Ember Gardens in part because of a stronger and more consistent review cadence. iMessage automation is standard practice in local SEO and declining it makes it harder to close the ranking gap on Seaside and The Haven Center over time. We would like to schedule a brief call to walk through how it works and address any concerns before making a final decision.
